known_text: My father doesn't like to stop talking.
target_text: 我爸爸不喜欢停止说话。

use.known: My father doesn't like to stop when he is working.
use.target: 我爸爸工作的时候不喜欢停止。

use.known: That young man asked me if I know your sister.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人问我是不是认识你姐姐。

use.known: If the old woman can tell me, I would be very happy.
use.target: 如果那个老女人能告诉我的话，我会很开心。

use.known: Everyone told me they want to meet your brother too.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们也想见你哥哥。

use.known: Would that young woman be able to help me with this?
use.target: 那个年轻的女人能帮我做这个吗？

use.known: She hopes I can remember what the old man said.
use.target: 她希望我能记住那个老人说了什么。

use.known: My father doesn't like to stop talking about work.
use.target: 我爸爸不喜欢停止说工作的话。

use.known: That young woman said her father wants to meet you.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人说她爸爸想见你。

use.known: If your father can come tomorrow, we can all talk.
use.target: 如果你爸爸明天能来的话，我们大家可以说话。

use.known: He told me his father remembers what happened.
use.target: 他告诉我他爸爸记住发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone here wants to meet your father someday.
use.target: 这里的大家都想有一天见你爸爸。

use.known: Does your father still want to work together with us?
use.target: 你爸爸还想和我们一起工作吗？

use.known: My father doesn't like to stop when we are talking.
use.target: 我爸爸我们说话的时候不喜欢停止。

use.known: That young man doesn't want to come to the meeting.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人不想来开会。

use.known: If you don't understand, you should ask someone.
use.target: 如果你不了解，你要问人。

use.known: She told me she doesn't know what happened yesterday.
use.target: 她告诉我她不知道昨天发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone here doesn't want to wait any longer.
use.target: 这里的大家都不想再等了。

use.known: Why doesn't your mother like to come to our place?
use.target: 你妈妈为什么不喜欢来我们这里？

use.known: My father doesn't like to stop reading his books.
use.target: 我爸爸不喜欢停止看他的书。

use.known: That young woman likes to practise speaking with us.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人喜欢和我们练习说话。

use.known: If you like this kind of work, you should do it.
use.target: 如果你喜欢这样的工作的话，你要做。

use.known: He told me he likes to help people when he can.
use.target: 他告诉我他能的时候喜欢帮人。

use.known: Everyone here likes to learn new things together.
use.target: 这里的大家都喜欢一起学新的东西。

use.known: What kind of things does your mother like to do?
use.target: 你妈妈喜欢做什么样的东西？

use.known: My father doesn't like to stop when he is reading.
use.target: 我爸爸看书的时候不喜欢停止。

use.known: That young man said we should stop and take a rest.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人说我们要停止休息一下。

use.known: If you want to stop, please let me know right away.
use.target: 如果你想停止的话，请让我知道。

use.known: She told me she will stop working when she is done.
use.target: 她告诉我她做完的时候会停止工作。

use.known: Everyone here wants to stop for a bit and rest.
use.target: 这里的大家都想停止一下休息。

use.known: When do you think your mother will stop talking?
use.target: 你觉得你妈妈什么时候会停止说话？

use.known: My father doesn't like to stop talking about himself.
use.target: 我爸爸不喜欢停止说自己的话。

use.known: That young woman likes to talk with your brother.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人喜欢和你哥哥说话。

use.known: If you want to talk now, I have time to listen.
use.target: 如果你现在想说话的话，我有时间听。

use.known: She told me her mother likes to talk about the past.
use.target: 她告诉我她妈妈喜欢说以前的话。

use.known: Everyone here enjoys talking together after work.
use.target: 这里的大家都喜欢工作以后一起说话。

use.known: Why does your father like to talk so much?
use.target: 你爸爸为什么喜欢说这么多话？
